'''Xavier Fernandez''' (born 19 November 1972) is an alpine skier who represented [[Andorra at the 2014 Winter Paralympics]]. He also competed in the [[2010 Winter Paralympics]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://m.sochi2014.com/en/paralympic/athlete-xavier-fernandez |title=Sochi 2014 profile |publisher=M.sochi2014.com |access-date=2014-03-05}}</ref>
